description: Answer from the office: sends each permission request (and AskUserQuestion question) to the local Habblaud (port in HABBLAUD_PORT, default 4747) and waits up to 5 min for the answer (up to 24 h with HABBLAUD_PERMISSION_TIMEOUT); if Habblaud is down or no page is open, it exits right away and the terminal answer counts.

hooks.statusMessage: Waiting for an answer in Habblaud
